completed_units: Derived the exact finite-convolution identity g*h=W_p+T_p and the normalized observer Delta_p-R_p congruent E_p=(W_p-p)/p^2 (mod p), so LIFT iff W_p congruent p (mod p^3).
Classified E_p as the smallest surviving second-digit observer after the accepted UR/JT0 bridges; the 166-prime scan is regression only.
Proved the exact p-adic shell law v_p(C_k)=floor(2k/p)+floor(3k/p) for C_k=binom(2k,k)^2 binom(3k,k)/216^k, hence the upper shell k=4m+1..6m is pointwise invisible modulo p^3.
For the p^2 boundary shell k=3m+r, proved the universal normalized recurrence a_{r+1}/a_r = r(6r-1)(6r+1)(3r+2)/(9(2r+1)^3(3r-1)) modulo p and the seed a_1=(4/9)(6/p).
Transported the entire p^2 boundary shell to a fixed-parameter length-m truncated 5F4 K_m, proving S_2/p^2 congruent (4/9)(6/p)K_m and E_p congruent E_low,p+(4/9)(6/p)K_m modulo p.
